Lina: FYI — finance POC: completely sealed site, no egress. They want a 30d on-prem eval, USB transfer only, signed bundles, SBOMs, and a simple acceptance checklist for their infra team. Asked for cost delta vs hosted.
Omar: got it. Do they need image-level attestation (UEFI signatures) or app-level package signing?
Lina: CISO: prefers both if possible, but app-level signing + SBOM is minimally acceptable. UEFI not required for the POC.
Zoe: we can produce minibundles signed by our HSM key. Two delivery models: (A) single full bundle (big, ~6GB) or (B) chunked deltas (recommended) with per-chunk manifest.sig. Deltas faster and fit USB sticks.
Zoe: sample bundle layout they can validate:
```
minibundle_v1/
  manifest.json
  manifest.sig   # signed by redwood-prod-hsm
  sbom.json
  chunks/
    chunk-0001.tar.gz
    chunk-0002.tar.gz
  meta/
    courier_receipt.txt
```
Omar: verification command for their infra team: `openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_root.pem -signature manifest.sig manifest.json`
Jason: Runbook note: include `sha256sum` for each chunk and a post-install smoke test (health check hitting localhost:8080/health). Keep steps <= 10 lines so their NOC can follow.
Carlos: Pricing: sealed/offline POC = standard private deploy fee + one-time packaging & signing fee (we sign each bundle) + optional courier verification add-on. For a 30d POC we can waive the platform fee but not the packaging fee. I'll draft numbers.
Lina: they also asked about rollback policy. Ops can only accept a single maintenance window per month.
Jason: implementation constraints: our operator keeps last active + staged image. We can support rollback to last-staged within the same major version. For cross-major rollbacks we need manual assist. Document this clearly.
Zoe: security: for air-gapped sites recommend key-wrap for trial license tokens. We generate a time-limited activation token, they import via USB, token expires after 30d. For HSM installs we require an SOW before issuing long-term keys.
Omar: also flag root CA rotation cadence — offline sites need an offline rotation plan; suggest yearly rotation with signed rotation manifest.
Lina: they want proof-of-delivery chain-of-custody logs. Any quick ideas?
Jason: include a courier_receipt.txt with SHA256 of the bundle, signed by our packing agent. They can scan receipt QR into their inventory. For higher assurance, use tamper-evident seals and record serial numbers.
Carlos: billing question: if they extend from 30d trial to paid private, packaging fee credits against first-year support. That's a standard concession we can offer.
KeyBot: deploy-checker: New sealed-poc task created -> ID: SEALED-POC-2024-04. Assignees: Jason, Carlos.
Lina: ok actions: 1) Carlos — draft pricing terms for 30d sealed POC and extension credit. 2) Jason — 1-page runbook + rollback SLA blurb. 3) Zoe — delta bundle spec + verify commands + SBOM template. 4) Omar — security Q answers for root rotation + token lifecycle.
Carlos: will have pricing sketch in 24h.
Jason: I'll mock the 1-pager and paste into this thread by EOD.
Zoe: will include `openssl` and `sha256sum` snippets and a JSON manifest example.
Omar: I'll write the security Q redlines before we share with customer.
Lina: thanks — I'll feed this back in the call tomorrow. :thumbsup:
